svg.text: MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Wind on a mandrel of (Dm − OD) diameter; tube filled with dry sand or a bending spring to prevent ovality > 5%.
2. Tube-in-tube (P05): insert 3/16" into 3/8" straight, then wind together; keep the inner tube centred with 3 wire spacers per turn.
3. Leads: 40 straight at each end unless stated; cut square, deburr, flush with citric acid 5% after forming.
4. Helix hand: right-hand for all coils. Pitch tolerance ±1 per turn, Dm ±1.
lower lead → HX hot outlet tee
cold: in bottom tee → out top tee (annulus)
hot: in top → out bottom (inner tube)
internal volume ≈ 61 mL (≈ 3 min at 1.2 L/h)
top: tee to standpipe P11; bottom → drawer
9.5 turns in the R1.65 groove of P08
